notes: The object suffix of וַיְנַהֲלוּם is read as the 'of them' of 'all the feeble of them'; the לְ before כָּל־כּוֹשֵׁל is left unrepresented, the ASV writing no function word for it.

In עִיר הַתְּמָרִים the rectum is rendered anarthrously, so rule 29's fronting applies: the article holds the single written 'the' and the construct 'city' holds none. The unit note's wording ('fronted to this word') describes the English position, not the assignment.
